title: Multitemporal Burnt Area Analysis (dNBR)
description: Bi-temporal Sentinel-2 burn severity mapping that differences the Normalized Burn Ratio between a pre-fire and a post-fire acquisition and classifies the result into unburned, moderate and severe, rendered over a natural-colour view of the post-fire scene.

attribution.citation: Key, C.H., Benson, N.C. (2006). Landscape Assessment (LA): Sampling and Analysis Methods. USDA Forest Service General Technical Report RMRS-GTR-164-CD.
